jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended with a fourth year for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (including statement of motivation summarizing prior scientific work) + 1-2 pages on research interests and vision for PhD work
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Master's thesis. If your thesis has not yet been completed, upload a draft version.
  • Documentation of English proficiency The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of ENglish language proficiency has been submitted
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Doctoral researcher in Building Services
jobs.description:
Do you want to explore how to combine sustainable building usage with occupant safety, well-being, and efficiency of user activities? We are looking for a doctoral researcher to join us at LUT University and contribute to research on high-performance, future-resilient, user-oriented sustainable buildings.

LUT Civil Engineering is a new, growing part of the LUT School of Energy Systems, and now hiring a doctoral researcher with a strong interest in bridging the gap between reduced real-life building energy usage and improved user satisfaction. We are looking for a curious, proactive researcher who enjoys continuous learning and wants to contribute to meaningful scientific discoveries with a positive impact on society.

We are also currently seeking other civil engineering professionals with a range of specialties; see our other job openings: https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/open-positions.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to research focusing on real-life building usage or on-demand ventilation control in buildings or industrial processes.

The position is based in the Building Services research group within the newly established LUT Civil Engineering team. You will work closely with your supervisor and the research group.

As a doctoral researcher, your primary goal is to complete your doctoral degree. This includes publishing peer-reviewed scientific articles and completing the required doctoral studies. In practice, your responsibilities include analysing and documenting research results, contributing to international scientific publications, and disseminating findings through channels such as conference presentations. As you will be participating in conferences and seminars, the position involves occasional travel.

The role also includes teaching and assisting in teaching at the bachelors and masters levels and supporting project or research group administration.

The selected candidate must apply for the right to pursue doctoral studies at the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of employment.

What we expect

A relevant masters degree is required. Your educational background may relate to HVAC, building automation, or a related field.

The role requires commitment to completing your doctoral studies within their normative timeframe. We value strong academic writing skills and motivation to contribute to scientific publications during your doctoral studies. Prior publications are not required but are considered an advantage.

Prior industry experience is an advantage, but early-career candidates are also encouraged to apply if they are eager to learn and take initiative.

Experience with or ambition to learn computational and experimental methods to analyse and develop building energy usage – such as system performance, room airflow patterns, and thermal and indoor air quality conditions – is considered an advantage.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential. We particularly value the ability to see the big picture behind the details. You should be able to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively in an international research environment. Excellent written and spoken English is required. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.

As the LUT Civil Engineering is just being established, you should be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where uncertainty and change are part of everyday work.

What we offer

We offer a collaborative research environment where you will contribute to societally relevant research, build your academic publication record, and receive close support from your supervisor throughout your doctoral studies.

The employment relationship starts with a one-year term. The contract may be extended by three years if your progress in your studies and research in the first year is satisfactory. The employment begins with a six-month trial period.

The work starts as soon as possible – preferably in November 2026, although the start date is negotiable. The position is based at LUTs Lahti campus in Finland. LUT offers a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular on-campus presence. The hours are flexible and support work–life balance. The position follows a system of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 4 October 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+3). Fill out the online form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- Motivation letter (one page) highlighting your research skills relevant to the position and describing why you are interested in and suitable for the position

- Curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity: https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae

- Copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records. If the original documents are not in English, Finnish, or Swedish, official certified translations are required

- Contact details of two references

Submit your application well before the deadline to allow time for uploading all attachments. Also, make sure you submit only one application.

Only applications that are submitted through the recruitment system and include the required documents will be considered. We will review applications on a rolling basis.

For more information, please contact Industry Professor Kim Hagström, kim.hagstrom@lut.fi.

LUT University | LUT University seeks solutions to global issues with its expertise in technology, business, and social sciences. LUT is a trailblazer in promoting the energy transition and the regenerative use of natural resources and helps build resilient communities, industry, and businesses through data, research, and education. LUT's campuses are in Lappeenranta and Lahti, Finland, but its impact is global.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager - Camurus (Lund)
jobs.description:
Camurus is an international, science-led biopharmaceutical company committed to developing and commercializing innovative, long-acting medicines for improving the lives of patients with severe and chronic diseases. New drug products with best-in-class potential are conceived based on the company’s proprietary FluidCrystal® technology and its extensive R&D expertise. The R&D pipeline includes products for the treatment of dependence, pain, cancer, and endocrine diseases. Camurus has operations across Europe, the US, and Australia, with headquarters in Lund Sweden. The company’s shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm under the ticker CAMX. For more information, visit www.camurus.com and LinkedIn.

In this role, you will get the opportunity to work in a broad and independent quality position, close to both internal functions and external partners. Camurus is a rapidly growing and international company, and you will play an important role in ensuring quality and compliance throughout the supply and distribution network. Always with the patient in mind.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Manager to join our Quality organization at Camurus headquarters in Lund.

This is a broad and independent role where you will work with quality assurance across Camurus' external supply and distribution network. You will have a key responsibility for quality agreements and quality aspects of supplier qualifications and monitoring, as well as for planning and conducting GDP and GMP audits. You will work closely with suppliers, distributors and other external partners, as well as with colleagues across the Camurus organization.

The role combines hands-on quality work with a broader responsibility for ensuring that processes and external partners comply with Camurus' Quality Management System and applicable regulatory requirements.

Your responsibility:

· Independently review, establish, negotiate and maintain Quality Technical Agreements (QTAs) with suppliers and distributors.

· Plan, conduct and document supplier qualifications and periodic supplier assessments.

· Plan and lead GDP and GMP audits of suppliers, distributors and other quality-critical partners, as well as internal audits.

· Lead deviation investigations, change controls, risk assessments and quality improvement initiatives.

· Provide quality and compliance support to the organization in matters related to GDP, GMP and regulatory requirements.

· Participate in regulatory inspections

· Ensure that quality processes are developed, maintained and followed in accordance with the Camurus Quality Management System.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with relevant internal functions and external partners.

Candidate profile We are looking for an experienced quality professional with approximately 7–10 years of experience from the pharmaceutical industry. You hold an academic degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biotechnology or another relevant Life Science discipline.

You have solid experience from working in a regulated pharmaceutical environment and a strong understanding of GDP and/or GMP. Experience as a Responsible Person (RP) or Qualified Person (QP) is considered a strong merit.

You have documented experience of planning, conducting and reporting supplier and GDP/GMP audits, as well as supplier qualification and ongoing supplier monitoring. You are also experienced in reviewing, negotiating and maintaining quality agreements with external partners.

A solid understanding of European pharmaceutical legislation and regulatory requirements is essential. Good understanding of US regulations and/or experience of regulatory requirements outside the EU is considered a strong merit, and experience in areas complementing traditional pharmaceutical regulation, such as combination products, is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are independent and confident in making decisions within your area of responsibility. You have high integrity and a pragmatic, yet quality-driven approach. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment with several parallel activities and are flexible enough to quickly adapt when priorities change. At the same time, you are collaborative and enjoy working cross-functionally across different parts of the organization. Fluency in spoken and written English is required.

Camurus offers This is a great time to join a highly dynamic company during an exciting phase of growth. Camurus has been very successful in bringing pharmaceutical products to the market - and the ambitions are to continue in the same way. With a diversified project portfolio in different stages, the commercial potential is considerable.

The position offers a broad and independent quality role with significant interaction across the organization and with external partners. You will have great opportunities to influence how Camurus works with quality and compliance as the company continues to grow internationally.

Camurus has 300 employees with the headquarters located in Lund. The corporate culture is driven by the core values of innovation, collaboration, ownership, quality, and passion for realizing a patient-centric commitment.

Information and application For more information about this job-opening, please contact recruitment consultant Tobias Lorentzon at TOBLOR Consulting, phone: +46 735 11 10 60. You apply for this position through TOBLOR’s career site, https://career.toblor.se/, by uploading your CV and personal letter. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. For more information about Camurus, please visit: www.camurus.com/.

We are looking forward to seeing your application!

jobs.title: Category Manager
jobs.description:
The sourcing organization at Husqvarna Forest & Garden Division is divided into several functions and categories, in order to secure quality, delivery, cost efficiency and sustainability throughout the supply chain. The Sourcing team is dedicated to deliver on our full range of business targets and to provide a profound base for our teams driving these objectives together with over 1000 suppliers and are guided by the principles of Strategic, Collaborative, and Professional. One of the key functions within Sourcing is category management and related commercial relationships with suppliers. Our task is to ensure that the greatest value is provided to the organization´s internal customers and thereby positively affecting the overall business result.

About the role

As Category Manager you are part of a highly motivated team of Category Managers and Operational Buyers and you report to the Sourcing Director Powertrain Categories. You will be overall responsible for the sourcing of accessories to Husqvarna Forest & Garden. This specific role will be responsible for accessories to robotics & wheeled portfolio. The accessories business is a highly strategic and profitable part of Husqvarna’s business offering. Your primary responsibility is to develop and apply business strategy and relationship management, deliver value in terms of quality, delivery, cost efficiency, innovation and sustainability for your categories during the full product life cycle.

You will step into a broad commercial role where you can build on your initial purchasing experience, gradually take on greater responsibility and continue developing within category management.

Your main tasks:

· Be ultimately responsible for all commercial relations with the suppliers within your categories and secure set targets of cost, quality, delivery and sustainability.

· Create long term strategies, well anchored with internal stakeholders, for your categories to deliver optimized value and drive implementation of the same.

· Develop and maintain vendor agreements.

· Manage sourcing projects and lead negotiations of commercial terms and conditions.

· Build and maintain mutually beneficial relations with suppliers in order to improve supplier performance and collaboration, not only to decrease costs and eliminate waste but also to utilize the suppliers full potential in areas such as product development and innovation.

· Build and maintain strong internal relations within sourcing functions such as Project Sourcing, Supplier Quality Assurance and Supplier Development but also with other internal stakeholders such as R&D, Product Management & Logistics.

·  Set up and manage the annual budget of cost saving activities and negotiations.

About you

To succeed in this role, we expect you have:

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, engineering, supply chain management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
    Around 2 to 3 years of experience within purchasing, sourcing or another relevant commercial role.
    A good commercial understanding and an interest in developing further within strategic sourcing and category management.
    Experience of working in an international environment is an advantage.
    Fluent in English

You also demonstrate a strong understanding of both internal and external customer service, complemented by exceptional communication abilities that encompass strategic thinking, diplomatic finesse, social competence, and negotiation skills.

Further it is of importance that you have strong influencing skills to promote Category Strategies to Business Partners, Experience and insights in the Purchasing environment and strong planning, analytical and organizing abilities.

Location and work setup

This role is based in Huskvarna. Occasional travel within service is expected, approximately 10 days per year.

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, send us your application including resumé and personal letter already today. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For questions regarding the position please contact hiring manager Johan Grauf at johan.grauf@husqvarnagroup.com.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Jonathan Olsson at jonathan.olsson@husqvarnagroup.com.

What happens after you apply?

The application period will be set during the summer and the selection process will start up in mid-to-late August. Do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions, but response time might be longer than usual due to the vacation period.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.  

Our culture is built on three core themes:  

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.  
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.  

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!  

Learn more about our culture here

jobs.title: Fagkoordinator i Miljøtjenesten
jobs.description:
Vil du bidra til å styrke rettssikkerhet, selvbestemmelse og faglig kvalitet for personer med utviklingshemming? 

Miljøtjenesten i Vestvågøy kommune søker en faglig sterk og engasjert fagkoordinator med et særlig ansvar for arbeidet etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kapittel 9. 

Miljøtjenesten gir helse- og omsorgstjenester til personer med utviklingshemming og andre funksjonsvariasjoner. Tjenestene omfatter blant annet døgnbemannede bofellesskap, ambulante tjenester og avlastning for barn og unge. Vårt mål er å tilby individuelt tilpassede og faglig forsvarlige tjenester som fremmer mestring, trygghet, selvbestemmelse og god livskvalitet.

Stillingen er nyopprettet og skal være en felles fagressurs for miljøtjenesten. Som fagkoordinator skal du bidra til en helhetlig og kunnskapsbasert praksis på tvers av avdelingene. Du vil samarbeide tett med enhetsleder, avdelingsledere, fagansvarlige og øvrige ansatte.

Arbeidet etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kapittel 9 skal ivareta rettssikkerheten ved bruk av tvang og makt overfor enkelte personer med utviklingshemming. Stillingen vil ha en sentral rolle i å styrke forebygging, brukermedvirkning, faglig forsvarlighet og systematisk evaluering i dette arbeidet. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Koordinere og videreutvikle miljøtjenestens arbeid etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kapittel 9
  • Veilede ledere og ansatte i faglige problemstillinger, med særlig vekt på forebygging og redusert bruk av tvang og makt
  • Bidra i kartlegging, risikovurdering, tiltaksutforming, dokumentasjon og evaluering
  • Sikre opplæring, kompetanseutvikling og faglig kvalitet i praksis og rutiner
  • Bidra til brukermedvirkning, samarbeid og erfaringsdeling på tvers av avdelinger og samarbeidspartnere
  • Delta i forbedringsarbeid, internkontroll og øvrige faglige utviklingsoppgaver
  • Dokumentering i journal-og fagsystemer
  • Andre faglige utviklingsoppgaver kan bli lagt til stillingen


Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som vernepleier
  • God kunnskap og erfaring med helse- og omsorgstjenestelovens kapittel 9
  • Erfaring med målrettet miljøarbeid og systematisk tiltaksarbeid
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter, interesse og erfaring med velferdsteknologi
  • Førerkort klasse B

 

    Personlige egenskaper

    Vi søker deg som: 

    • Er faglig trygg, tydelig og engasjert
    • Har høy etisk bevissthet og et sterkt engasjement for den enkeltes rettssikkerhet
    • Bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet

    Ved vurdering av søkerliste vil vi legge stor vekt på personlig egnethet, relevant erfaring og motivasjon for stillingen.

    Vestvågøy kommunes verdier - Respekt, tillit, åpenhet, raushet og mangfold - skal være synlige i møte med tjenestemottakere, pårørende, kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere. Verdiene ligger også til grunn for Miljøtjenestens strategiske arbeid. 

    Vi tilbyr
    • Flyttegodtgjørelse.
    • Tariffestede pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
    • Velferdstiltak, blant annet treningsavtale.
    • Godt fagmiljø der du kan være med på å utvikle kommunens tjenester.


      Arbeidstakere tilsettes i Vestvågøy kommune etter gjeldende lover, reglement og tariffavtale. Prøvetiden er 6 måneder i faste 
      stillinger. Det kreves tilfredsstillende politiattest før tiltredelse.

      Ditt navn kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om unntak, jf. Offentleglova. Før søkerliste blir offentliggjort, vil du bli 
      kontaktet dersom du har bedt om unntak.
    KontaktinformasjonMads Tangen, +47 91798658
    ArbeidsstedStorgata 37
    8370 LEKNES

    Referansenr.: 5173461306
    Stillingsprosent: 100%
    Fast
    Søknadsfrist: 04.10.2026

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Midt i Lofoten finner du Vestvågøy, en kommune i vekst med 11 500 innbyggere. Vi har sykehus og flyplass, videregående skole og gode forbindelser med hurtigrute og buss. Idretts- og kulturlivet er rikt, og her er muligheter for et mangfoldig friluftsliv. Vi er stolte av det arbeidet vi gjør og er opptatt av å yte gode tjenester til våre innbyggere. Stolt Lofoting er vår visjon, og verdiene vi strekker oss etter er åpenhet, raushet, respekt, tillit og mangfold.

jobs.title: Veileder i sosialteam
jobs.description:
Nav Vestre Aker er en spennende arbeidsplass med høyt kvalifiserte og motiverte medarbeidere, og med et godt arbeidsmiljø. Vi er lokalisert i Sørkedalsveien 150, og betjener bydelens innbyggere på ca. 50.000.  

Vi søker nå en veileder til vårt sosialteam som skal jobbe med sosialfaglig oppfølging av sosialhjelpsmottakere og saksbehandling etter Lov om sosiale tjenester. I stillingen vil du også samarbeide tett med veiledere som følger opp mot arbeid. 

Vi søker deg som tror på muligheter, tenker helhetlig og som er god på veiledning og på å bygge relasjoner. Du er opptatt av å ivareta mennesker, og våger deg inn i utfordrende samtaler. Du har et stort engasjement for Navs samfunnsoppdrag, og du tåler det å stå i en jobb som krever evne til å være strukturert i en hverdag som aldri er lik.  

Nav Vestre Aker er et kontor i stadig utvikling for å sikre at vi til enhver tid tilbyr tjenester til beste for brukerne våre. Arbeidsoppgavene i stillingen kan endres, og du må derfor trives med endring. 

Vi utlyser et vikariat ut juni 2027 med mulighet for forlengelse.   

Intervjuer er planlagt fredag 2. oktober.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Helhetlig, sosialfaglig oppfølging 
  • Tett samarbeid med andre veiledere i kontoret med mål å bistå felles brukere ut i ordinært arbeid 
  • Økonomisk råd og veiledning 
  • Kartlegge ressurser og bistå med å finne muligheter til aktivitet for den enkelte 
  • Samarbeide med relevante aktører i og utenfor Nav-kontoret, herunder andre tjenester i bydelen, fastleger, spesialisthelsetjenesten, frivillige organisasjoner med mer. 
  • Kartlegging av økonomiske rettigheter og saksbehandling etter Lov om sosiale tjenester i Nav  
 Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fullført utdanning på minimum bachelornivå, fortrinnsvis innenfor helse- og sosialfag, humanistiske, juridiske eller samfunnsvitenskapelige fag  
  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne  
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra saksbehandling etter Lov om sosiale tjenester  
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker  
  • Overblikk og forståelse for Nav sitt virkeområde og samspill med øvrige samarbeidspartnere
  • Generelt god kompetanse på IKT- og dataverktøy  
  • En helhetlig tankegang og forståelse for oppfølging av mennesker med sammensatte utfordringer og behov  
  • En forståelse for hvordan arbeid og aktivitet kan brukes for å inkludere mennesker som av ulike årsaker står utenfor arbeidslivet 
  • Du må kunne strukturere og prioritere arbeidet med egen portefølje 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er god på relasjonsbygging og se andres ressurser  
  • Du tenker helhetlig og finner gode løsninger 
  • Du er god til å samarbeide og motivere – og du skaper og deler gode løsninger med kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere  
  • Du er selvstendig, selvgående og fatter egne beslutninger  
  • Du er omstillingsdyktig og trives med å bidra i endringsprosesser – både arbeidshverdagen og samfunnet endrer seg raskt  
  • Du håndterer en tidvis høy arbeidsmengde og et høyt tempo 
Vi tilbyr
  • Meningsfulle og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver  
  • Engasjerte kollegaer 
  • Store muligheter for å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag  
  • Store muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling  
  • Innplassering som sosialkonsulent i stillingskode 0106000, lønnsramme 22, alt. 7 (34-43). Dette tilsvarer en årslønn mellom kr.  633 200 – 740 600.  
  • God pensjonsordning gjennom Oslo pensjonskasse  
KontaktinformasjonVilde Borgersen (fraværende t.o.m. 23.09.), Avdelingsleder , 45 86 33 87, vilde.borgersen@nav.no
Heidi Hauge Lauvsland (tilgjengelig i leders fravær), Fagkoordinator, 412 84 136, heidi.hauge@nav.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Bydel Vestre Aker har vi som målsetning å skape selvstendighet, mestring, trygghet og fellesskap gjennom våre tjenestetilbud. Våre ansatte er en viktig ressurs i dette arbeidet, og vi er opptatte av å rekruttere dyktige medarbeidere som ønsker å skape gode fremtidsrettede tjenester for bydelens beboere. Bydelen ligger vest i Oslo med kort vei til sentrum, og det bor ca. 50 000 innbyggere her. 

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

jobs.title: IT-tuki- ja ylläpitoasiantuntija, Keliber-litiumhanke
jobs.description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.
Haluatko tarttua ainutlaatuiseen tilaisuuteen ja tulla luomaan uuden sukupolven suomalaista teollisuutta?
Vahvistamme ICT-tiimiämme ja haemme nyt joukkoomme

IT-TUKI- JA YLLÄPITOASIANTUNTIJAA

vastaamaan kaivoksen, rikastamon, jalostamon ja hallinnollisten toimintojen päivittäisestä operatiivisesta ICT-tuesta Keliber-litiumhankkeessa. Roolissasi tuet loppukäyttäjiä, laitteita, infrastruktuuria, käyttäjähallintaa ja operatiivisia ICT-palveluita sekä varmistat, että toiminta noudattaa yrityksen standardeja, tietoturvavaatimuksia ja hallintamalleja. Yhtiön toimipisteet sijaitsevat Keski-Pohjanmaalla Kokkolassa ja Kaustisella. Raportoit tehtävässäsi ICT johtajalle.
Odotamme sinulta
vähintään tieto- tai automaatiotekniikan perustutkintoa; tai muu soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto, kuten datanomin tai insinöörin tutkinto
vähintään 3–5 vuoden työkokemusta ICT-tukitoiminnoista, kaivos-, teollisuus- tai tuotantoympäristön tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
kokemusta Microsoft 365-ympäristöistä, käyttäjähallinnasta (AD ja Entra ID), työasematuesta sekä palvelunhallintatyökaluista
asiakaslähtöistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä vahvoja vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan, hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä ammatillisesti osana kunnianhimoista ja innostunutta työyhteisöä. Meillä turvallisuus on aina etusijalla, ja teollisuusyrityksenä kiinnitämme erityistä huomiota ympäristöasioiden kestävään hoitamiseen. Ymmärrämme työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamisen merkityksen hyvinvoinnille, jota tuemme mm. liukuvalla työajalla ja mahdollistamalla etätyö työtehtävien salliessa.
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ICT johtaja Freddie Nortje, p. +27 731 980 702, freddie.nortje@sibanyestillwater.com.
Hae tehtävään 30.9.2026 mennessä.

Keliber is an advanced lithium project, located in Kaustinen and Kokkola, Finland. Keliber aims to be the first European producer of battery-grade lithium hydroxide from its own mined ore reserves. Lithium hydroxide is used in lithium-ion batteries that play a significant role in the green transition. Keliber is a subsidiary of Sibanye-Stillwater, a multinational mining and metals processing Group, with Finnish Minerals Group as the second largest shareholder, a state-owned company developing the value chain of lithium-ion batteries.
Would you like to take on this unique chance and create new generations industry in Finland?
We are strengthening our ICT team and are now looking for a
ICT SUPPORT & OPERATIONS SPECIALIST
To take responsibility for the day-to-day operational ICT support for the mine, concentrator, refinery, and administrative functions in the Keliber lithium project. In this role, you will provide support for end users, equipment, infrastructure, user management, and operational ICT services, and ensure that operations comply with the companys standards, information security requirements, and governance models. The company's offices are located in Kokkola and Kaustinen in Central Ostrobothnia. You will report to the Senior Manager Digital Enablement.

In order to succeed, we expect You to:
Have at least a bachelors degree in information technology or automation engineering; or another relevant degree from a university of applied sciences such as a degree in data science or engineering
Have at least 3–5 years of work experience in ICT support functions; familiarity with mining, industrial, or manufacturing environments is considered an asset
Have experience with Microsoft 365 environments, user management (AD and Entra ID), workstation support, and service management tools
Have a customer-oriented and solution-focused approach to work, as well as strong interpersonal and collaboration skills
Fluent Finnish and English language skills

In addition to competitive salary and good benefits, we offer excellent opportunities for professional development in an ambitious and exciting work community. For us, safety is always a priority, and as an industrial company we give special attention to handling environmental matters sustainably. We understand the significance of balance between work and private life and support this for example with flexible working hours and providing the option for remote work when possible.
For further information please contact Freddie Nortje, Senior Manager Digital Enablement, tel. +27 731 980 702, freddie.nortje@sibanyestillwater.com

Apply by 30 September 2026.

jobs.title: Efterskoleleder til Hjemly Idrætsefterskole
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en efterskole, hvor høje ambitioner går hånd i hånd med nærvær, relationer og modet til at udvikle?

Vi er en attraktiv idrætsefterskole med 241 elever og en engageret medarbejdergruppe. Vi tror på, at unge mennesker udvikler sig bedst gennem trygge relationer og stærke fællesskaber. Vores ambition er at skabe en efterskole, hvor elever udvikler sig sportsligt, fagligt, personligt og socialt – og hvor medarbejderne oplever frihed, ansvar og tillid.

 

Om Hjemly

 Hjemly er en kombineret fri skole med tre enheder: en idrætsefterskole, en friskole og en skov- og idrætsbørnehave. Samlet er vi omkring 500 børn og unge på matriklen og mere end 90 ansatte. Vi har et fælles ledelsesgrundlag.

 

En efterskole med stærke værdier – og mod til at udvikle

Vi arbejder ud fra en anerkendende tilgang, hvor relationen er udgangspunktet for både ledelse, undervisning og dannelse. Vi tror på, at tydelighed og omsorg er forudsætninger for hinanden.

Hjemly er en efterskole i bevægelse. De senere år har vi udviklet nye undervisningsformer, styrket trivselsarbejdet, arbejdet med professionelle læringsfællesskaber og skabt en kultur, hvor pædagogisk udvikling er et fælles ansvar. Den udvikling ønsker vi, at du er med til at fortsætte.

 

Din opgave:

Vi søger en leder, der indgår naturligt i ledelsesteamet med de to øvrige efterskoleledere og herigennem bidrager til udviklingen af efterskolen. I efterskoleledelsen er vi nysgerrige og ærlige i drøftelserne og vi taler os frem til enighed. Samarbejde er et nøgleord og skaber grobund for gode beslutninger, når flere perspektiver inddrages. Ledelsesteamet er et fagligt inspirerende rum, hvor der er pldas til at fejle . Du træder ind i en kultur, hvor dialogen er i højsædet, både i ledelsen og med medarbejderne.

Du får en central rolle i både den strategiske udvikling og daglige ledelse af skolen. Det betyder, at du skal være med til at skabe retning for efterskolens fortsatte udvikling og samtidig være tæt på den hverdag, hvor elever, medarbejdere og forældre mødes.

Du bliver leder for efterskolen, og du sidder i Hjemlys samlede ledergruppe sammen med skoledirektøren, lederen af friskolen og lederen af børnehaven.

Din opgaveportefølje bliver at være tovholder for følgende opgaver i ledelsesteamet:

  • sætte den pædagogiske retning og lede skolens fortsatte udviklingsarbejde

  • udvikle undervisning, evaluering og læringsmiljøer i tæt samarbejde med medarbejderne

  • understøtte professionelle læringsfællesskaber gennem sparring, kollegial supervision og pædagogiske dage

  • have personaleansvar med kompetenceudvikling, trivsel, MUS-samtaler og daglig ledelsessparring

  • skabe rum for dialog, refleksion og fælles beslutninger

  • være en synlig leder i efterskolens hverdag og deltage aktivt i fællessamlinger og efterskolelivet

  • være en nærværende sparringspartner for elever, medarbejdere og forældre – både når hverdagen fungerer, og når den udfordrer

  • være med til at planlægge efterskolens årshjul, pædagogiske aktiviteter, evalueringer og den løbende udvikling af rammer og indhold

  • samarbejde med efterskolens ressourcepersoner om læsevejledning, UU, inklusion, sociale indsatser og elevernes samlede trivsel

  • sikre en tydelig og nærværende kommunikation gennem nyhedsbreve, digitale platforme og efterskolens eksterne formidling.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du...

  • har erfaring med ledelse – gerne fra efterskole- eller uddannelsesverdenen

  • brænder for efterskolens dannelsesopgave og tror på relationen som den vigtigste drivkraft

  • kan skabe følgeskab gennem tillid, dialog og tydelig retning

  • har stærke pædagogiske kompetencer og motiveres af at udvikle undervisning og læringsmiljøer

  • ser udviklingen af medarbejdere som en af dine vigtigste opgaver

  • kan navigere mellem strategi og de mange relationer, der præger en efterskoles hverdag

  • er synlig, nærværende og motiveres af at være en aktiv del af efterskolens liv

 

Skal du være med?

Hjemly er svær at få det fulde overblik over via en hjemmeside, så kom og besøg os. Rundvisning aftaler du med Jonas R. Karsten, administrativ pædagogisk leder — jrk@hjemly.dk, 6013 9772

Praktiske oplysninger:

Ansøgningsfrist torsdag den 8. oktober 2026 kl. 12.00

Ansøgningen sendes til job@hjemly.dk — ansøgning, CV og øvrige relevante dokumenter i én samlet PDF-fil. Som en del af ansøgningen, er du velkommen til at sende en kort præsentationsvideo via et link til Youtube.

Tiltrædelse efter aftale

Samtaler: Første samtale er den 19. oktober, anden samtale den 22. oktober. Vi kontakter minimum to referencer, inden vi træffer en beslutning. Der indhentes børneattest inden ansættelse.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår iht. organisationsaftale for ledere ved frie grundskoler mv. af 28. august 2026. Der er mulighed for bolig.

Læs mere om os på www.hjemly.dk.

jobs.title: Stillingsopslag – Teknisk medarbejder
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Doctoral researchers in Construction Business
jobs.description:
Do you want to explore how the green and digital twin transition shapes society and business? We are looking for doctoral researchers to join us at LUT University and contribute to research on business model transformation in the real estate and construction industry.

LUT Civil Engineering is a new, growing part of the LUT School of Energy Systems, and now hiring three doctoral researchers with a strong interest in the green and digital twin transition and a background in circular economy in the field of construction. We are seeking candidates who are curious, aspire to an academic career, are committed to continuous learning, and want to contribute to socially relevant scientific knowledge.

We are also currently seeking other civil engineering professionals with a range of specialties; see our other job openings: https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/open-positions.

What your work will be like

You will contribute to transdisciplinary research focusing on one of the following:

- Life cycle assessment and management of built assets

- National building stock inventory and scenarios

- Business model innovation in real estate and construction

The positions are based in the Construction Business research group within the newly established LUT Civil Engineering team. You will work closely with your supervisor and the research group.

As a doctoral researcher, your primary goal is to complete your doctoral degree. This includes publishing peer-reviewed scientific articles and completing the required doctoral studies. In practice, your responsibilities include analysing and documenting research results, contributing to international scientific publications, and disseminating findings through, e.g., conference presentations. As you will be participating in conferences and seminars, the position involves occasional travel.

The role also includes teaching and assisting in teaching at the bachelors and masters levels and supporting project or research group administration.

The selected candidates must apply for the right to pursue doctoral studies at the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of employment.

What we expect

A relevant masters degree is required. Your educational background may relate to construction economics and management, real estate economics, industrial engineering and management, or a related field.

The role requires commitment to completing your doctoral studies within their normative timeframe. We value strong academic writing skills and motivation to contribute to scientific publications during your doctoral studies. Prior publications are not required but are considered an advantage.

Prior industry experience is an advantage, but early-career candidates are also encouraged to apply if they are eager to learn and take initiative.

We particularly value experience in conducting and developing life cycle assessments (economic, environmental, social). Experience in business model innovation, real estate development, and the construction process are considered an advantage.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential. You should be able to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively in an international research environment. Excellent written and spoken English is required. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.

As the LUT Civil Engineering is just being established, you should be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where uncertainty and change are part of everyday work.

What we offer

We offer a collaborative research environment where you will contribute to societally relevant research, build your academic publication record, and receive close supervision support throughout your doctoral studies.

The employment relationship starts with a one-year term. The contract may be extended by three years if your progress in your studies and research in the first year is satisfactory. The employment begins with a six-month trial period.

The work starts in November 2026, although the start date is negotiable. The position is based at LUTs Lahti campus in Finland. LUT offers a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular on-campus presence. The hours are flexible and support work–life balance. The position follows a system of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 4 October 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+3). Fill out the online form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A motivation letter (one page) highlighting your research skills relevant to the position and describing why you are interested in and suitable for the position

- A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity: https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae

- Copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records. If the original documents are not in English, Finnish, or Swedish, official certified translations are required

- Contact details of two references

Please also indicate which of the three topics interests you most.

Submit your application well before the deadline to allow time for uploading all attachments. Also, make sure you submit only one application.

Only applications that are submitted through the online recruitment system and include the required documents will be considered. We will review applications on a rolling basis, and the positions will be filled once suitable candidates are found.

For more information, please contact Professor Riikka Kyrö, riikka.kyro@lut.fi.

LUT University | LUT University seeks solutions to global issues with its expertise in technology, business, and social sciences. LUT is a trailblazer in promoting the energy transition and the regenerative use of natural resources and helps build resilient communities, industry, and businesses through data, research, and education. LUT's campuses are in Lappeenranta and Lahti, Finland, but its impact is global.

jobs.title: Nestleder i barnevernstjenesten
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å utvikle framtidens barnevern? 

Barnevernstjenesten søker en engasjert, faglig sterk og utviklingsorientert nestleder som ønsker å bidra til at barn, unge og familier får riktig hjelp til riktig tid. 

Som nestleder blir du en sentral del av lederteamet og får en viktig rolle i å sikre høy faglig kvalitet, forsvarlig drift og videre utvikling av tjenesten. Vi søker deg som trives med ansvar, bygger gode relasjoner og ønsker å bidra til et barnevern der barnets beste alltid står i sentrum. 

Om barnevernstjenesten 

Barnevernstjenesten skal sikre barn og unge som lever under forhold som kan skade deres helse og utvikling, får nødvendig hjelp, omsorg og beskyttelse til rett tid. Vi arbeider målrettet for å tilby trygge tjenester, god faglig kvalitet og gode løsninger i tett samarbeid med barn, familier og våre samarbeidspartnere.  

Tjenesten består av omlag 40 årsverk og er organisert i fire team: 

  • Undersøkelse 
  • Tiltak
  • Omsorg
  • Enslige mindreårige

Hvert team ledes av en fagleder. Barnevernstjenesten deltar i interkommunal barnevernvakt og er vertskommune for Innherredskommunenes familie- og nettverksprosjekt. Prosjektet skal etableres som et permanent tiltak fra 2027. Familieråd benyttes aktivt i alle faser av barnevernssaker.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Som nestleder vil du: 

  • Inngå i barnevernstjenestens lederteam sammen med barnevernsleder og fagledere. 
  • Være stedfortreder for barnevernsleder ved fravær. 
  • Ha et særlig ansvar for koordinering og utvikling av tjenestens akuttarbeid. 
  • Ha fagansvar for Familie- og nettverkstiltaket på Innherred.
  • Bidra til fagutvikling, kvalitetssikring og internkontroll. 
  • Være systemansvarlig for tjenestens fagsystem. 
  • Sikre at rutiner, prosedyrer og maler er oppdaterte og i tråd med gjeldende lovverk. 
  • Delta i mottaksmøter og faglige vurderinger av nye meldinger og saker. 
  • Veilede og følge opp ansatte, nyansatte og studenter. 
  • Bistå i komplekse saker, akuttsaker og saker som behandles i nemnd eller domstol.
  • Bidra til økonomioppfølging, rapportering og saksframlegg. 
  • Samarbeide tett med kommunale tjenester, spesialisthelsetjenesten, politi, skole og øvrige samarbeidspartnere.
  • Delta aktivt i utviklingsarbeid og innovasjon innen tjenesten.  

Organisasjonen er i kontinuerlig utvikling. Fremtidige endringer i tjenestens organisering og oppgaveportefølje kan derfor forekomme.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Bachelorgrad i barnevern, sosialt arbeid eller annen relevant helse- og sosialfaglig utdanning. 
  • Relevant videreutdanning i tråd med kompetansekravene i barnevernet. 
  • Minimum fire års erfaring fra kommunalt barnevern. 
  • Erfaring fra offentlig sektor og arbeid med barnevernssaker.
  • God kjennskap til aktuelt lovverk og saksbehandling. 
  • God digital kompetanse og interesse for system- og kvalitetsarbeid. 
  • God muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne. 

Det er en fordel om du også har: 

  • Mastergrad innen barnevern eller annet relevant fagområde. 
  • Ledererfaring og/eller lederutdanning. 
  • Videreutdanning innen veiledning.
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Er en tydelig og tilgjengelig leder. 
  • Har stor faglig integritet og gode etiske vurderinger. 
  • Er strukturert, systematisk og har god gjennomføringsevne.
  • Er løsningsorientert og utviklingsfokusert. 
  • Har gode samarbeids- og relasjonsferdigheter.
  • Evner å stå trygt i krevende situasjoner og komplekse beslutninger. 
  • Motiverer, støtter og utfordrer medarbeidere på en konstruktiv måte. 
 Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende og meningsfull lederstilling i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. 
  • Mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av framtidens barnevern. 
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kollegaer. 
  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. 
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. 
  • Lønn etter avtale og gjeldende tariffavtale. 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Arbeidstakere ansettes i kommunen på de vilkår som følger av lovbestemmelser, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtaler. De første 6 måneder er prøvetid.

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska till Hematologiavdelning i Lund
jobs.description:
Gör skillnad. Varje dag.

Nu söker vi en ny kollega som vill bli en av pusselbitarna på vår arbetsplats! Är det dig vi söker?

På hematologavdelningarna i Lund vårdar vi patienter med framför allt maligna blodsjukdomar där stamcellstransplantation är en viktig del i behandlingen. Hos oss arbetar sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, medicinska sekreterare och läkare. Därtill har vi fysioterapeut, arbetsterapeut och dietist som en del av vårt fantastiska team. Att arbeta i teamet är inspirerande då patienterna uttrycker att de blir både sedda, bekräftade och väl omhändertagna. Vi har en fantastisk sammanhållning, som ger en trygghet. Vi ser oss alla som viktiga pusselbitar och tillsammans skapar och utvecklar vi vår arbetsplats.

Det är inte bara sammanhållningen i teamet som sticker ut hos oss utan våra sjuksköterskor vittnar om att det är ett spännande område, där man hela tiden utvecklas och vi trivs med våra fantastiska patienter i alla åldrar som vi skapar en fin relation till. Liksom andra avdelningar händer det att vi har dagar då tempot är högt, men då hjälps vi åt!  Vi är måna om att du som ny medarbetare ska komma in i din roll på ett bra sätt, och därför välkomnas du med ett väl utarbetat introduktionsprogram. När introduktionen är klar får du fortsatt stöd av en personlig mentor i form av en erfaren kollega. Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för all personal, både med interna och externa utbildningar. Vid personligt intresse finns det möjlighet att studera till specialistsjuksköterska inom cancervård.

Vill du vara en del av vår verksamhet där teamarbete och utveckling värderas högt? Då är du välkommen att söka till oss!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker dig som tycker om ditt arbete som sjuksköterska och känner stort ansvar och engagemang inför uppgiften!

I rollen som sjuksköterska har du en central roll för våra patienter. En del av våra patienter är svårt sjuka och kräver högspecialiserad vård, vilket gör att du får en bred erfarenhet. Under ett vanligt arbetspass ansvarar du och din undersköterska tillsammans för fyra till fem patienter.

Vi är i en spännande fas där vi öppnat en ny form av dagvård, där vi erbjuder fler möjligheter till våra patienter att erhålla delar av sin behandling utanför slutenvårdstillfället. Dagvården bedrivs av ett team från slutenvården, där du som sjuksköterska kan få möjlighet till att bredda din kompetens ytterligare.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi välkomnar dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska med behörighet att verka inom svensk sjukvård. Språkkunskaper i svenska motsvarande lägst nivå C1 enligt Europarådets nivåskala är ett krav.

Du har en positiv inställning och ser saker från sin ljusa sida. Du visar omtanke för både patienter och kollegor och vill gärna lära dig nya saker. Du har god förmåga att arbeta såväl självständigt som i team. Då vi värnar om vår goda stämning lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

I den här rekryteringen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

Region Skåne är en värderingsstyrd organisation som arbetar med värderingarna välkomnande, drivande, omtanke och respekt i allt vi gör.

Skånes universitetssjukhus (Sus) finns i Lund och Malmö och är landets tredje största sjukhus. Sus är ett kunskapsnav för hälso- och sjukvård i livets alla skeden på regional, nationell och internationell nivå. Våra 12 000 medarbetare är med och driver utvecklingen inom universitetssjukhusets tre uppdragsområden: vård, forskning och utbildning. Hos oss får du arbeta i en värderingsstyrd organisation som utvecklar hälso- och sjukvården tillsammans med patienter och deras närstående. Välkommen!

På https://www.skane.se/ledigajobb  kan du se i vilket skede Region Skånes rekryteringar befinner sig och hur många som har sökt tjänsterna.

jobs.title: Chef de projet Expérience Professionnels de Santé (H/F/X) - France (Paris)
jobs.description:
Votre Rôle

Au sein de l'équipe B2B France, vous êtes responsable de construire et de développer une expérience forte et cohérente pour notre réseau de professionnels de santé, en particulier à travers les congrès, événements, formations et autres opportunités d’interaction .

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Regional Managers afin d’identifier les opportunités du terrain et de construire une stratégie événementielle permettant de maximiser la qualité et l’impact de ces interactions.

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie d’acquisition et d’expérience événementielle B2B en identifiant les congrès, événements, formations, webinars et autres opportunités d’interaction avec les professionnels de santé, et en construisant un calendrier annuel cohérent avec les objectifs de l'entreprise

  • Piloter l’organisation et la préparation des congrès et événements en coordonnant les différents interlocuteurs internes et externes afin de créer une expérience professionnelle et cohérente pour les participants

  • Développer des formats d’expérience et d’interaction adaptés aux professionnels de santé, notamment des formations, workshops, webinars, petits-déjeuners ou événements régionaux, en fonction des besoins identifiés sur le terrain

  • Maximiser l’acquisition et la conversion en collaborant avec les Regional Managers afin d'identifier les besoins d’activation du réseau, transformer les besoins communs en initiatives scalables et assurer la continuité entre événement, activation et suivi

  • Construire une expérience professionnelle différenciante en concevant le parcours du professionnel avant, pendant et après l’événement afin de renforcer son engagement envers Sunday Natural

  • Mesurer et optimiser la performance en analysant la participation, la qualité des leads, les conversions, l’engagement et le ROI afin d’identifier les événements les plus performants

Votre Profil

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation avec orientation scientifique (nutrition, biologie, santé ou domaine similaire) et vous disposez d’une première expérience en marketing, événementiel ou gestion de projet

  • Vous avez une bonne capacité à comprendre et vulgariser des sujets scientifiques et êtes à l’aise pour échanger sur des thématiques scientifiques avec différents interlocuteurs

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), autonome et avez de solides compétences en gestion de projet et coordination, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs événements et parties prenantes simultanément

  • Vous avez une approche orientée business et savez évaluer la pertinence d’une opportunité, prioriser les investissements et mesurer leur impact

  • Vous aimez travailler de manière transverse avec les équipes commerciales, marketing, Brand et Product et êtes capable de transformer les besoins du terrain en expériences pertinentes et scalables

  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais (à l'écrit comme à l'oral). Ce poste est basé dans nos bureaux à Paris.

À noter : L'anglais étant notre langue d'entreprise, la communication avec le siège ainsi que les premiers entretiens se dérouleront en anglais

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une réduction attractive sur l'ensemble de nos produits - des huiles essentielles aux vitamines et nutriments.

  • Parce que les plus belles réussites naissent des rencontres, nous adoptons un modèle hybride avec un jour de télétravail par semaine (jusqu'à deux selon votre département) et la possibilité de travailler jusqu'à deux semaines par an depuis l'étranger.

  • Une réelle autonomie, un terrain propice aux initiatives, ainsi que l'opportunité d'apporter votre expertise et de concrétiser vos meilleures idées.

  • Des espaces de travail accueillants avec un accès privilégié à une large sélection de thés biologiques et de superfoods du monde entier.

  • Nous aimons célébrer nos succès ensemble ! Événements réguliers, tea parties, fêtes de Noël et d'été, ainsi que diverses activations influenceurs (comme pour la Journée internationale des droits des femmes).

Postulez en envoyant votre CV et votre lettre de motivation - idéalement en anglais.

Engagement & Event Manager – Healthcare (all genders) - France (Paris)

Your role

As part of the French B2B team, you will be responsible for building and developing a strong and consistent experience for our healthcare professional network, particularly through congresses, events, training and other engagement opportunities.

You will work closely with the Regional Managers to identify opportunities and needs from the field and build an event strategy that maximizes the quality and impact of these interactions.

  • Define and lead the B2B acquisition and event experience strategy by identifying congresses, events, trainings, webinars and other opportunities to engage with healthcare professionals, and building an annual calendar aligned with the company’s objectives

  • Lead the organization and preparation of congresses and events, coordinating internal and external stakeholders to create a professional and consistent experience for participants

  • Develop experience and engagement formats tailored to healthcare professionals, including trainings, workshops, webinars, breakfasts and regional events, based on needs identified in the field

  • Maximize acquisition and conversion by working with Regional Managers to identify network activation needs, turning common needs into scalable initiatives and ensuring continuity between events, activation and follow-up

  • Build a differentiated healthcare professional experience by designing the professional journey before, during and after each event to strengthen engagement with Sunday Natural

  • Measure and optimize performance by analyzing attendance, lead quality, conversion, engagement and ROI to identify the highest-performing events and continuously improve our event strategy

Your profile

  • You have a scientific background or degree in nutrition, biology, healthcare or a similar field and you have initial experience in marketing, event or project management

  • You have a strong ability to understand and communicate scientific topics in an accessible way and feel comfortable discussing scientific subjects with different stakeholders

  • You are organized, autonomous and have strong project management and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple events and stakeholders simultaneously

  • You have a business-oriented mindset and are able to assess the relevance of opportunities, prioritize investments and measure their impact

  • You enjoy working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Brand and Product teams and are able to turn field needs into relevant and scalable experiences

  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken)

Please note: As English is our company language, internal communication and initial interviews will take place in English.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 25 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

jobs.title: Timanställda och vikarier till Kriscentrum boende heder
jobs.description:
Ref: 20261971

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu timvikarier till Kriscentrum Boende Heder inför jul och nyår.

Boende Heder är ett HVB (hem för vård eller boende) för flickor och unga kvinnor i åldern 14–22 år som är utsatta för hedersvåld och som har ett skyddsbehov.

Personal utreder skyddsbehovet och under hela placeringstiden samarbetar personalen nära placerande socialsekreterare. Som socialsekreterare arbetar du med informativa och stödjande samtal, skyddsbedömningar, joursamtal via telefon, dokumentation samt samverkan med socialtjänst, sjukvård, advokat och polis med mera. Arbetet består också av praktiska arbetsuppgifter i boendet samt aktiviteter för barn och vuxna såväl i boendet som utanför.

Vi rekryterar nu timvikarier för tjänstgöring dag, kväll, helg och natt.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är socionomstuderande och har läst juridikterminen eller har socionomexamen. Det är meriterande om du har utbildning och/eller erfarenhet av arbete inom nedan angivna områden:

    Hedersrelaterat våld
    Våld i nära relation
    Arbete på boende
    Patriark/HEVA
    FREDA
    TMO
    Arbete med ungdomar

Som person vill vi att du har en god samarbetsförmåga som gör att du lyssnar in samt visar intresse och förståelse för andra människor. Du har ett gott bemötande och förmågan att skapa goda relationer med andra. Vidare kan du planera arbetet självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter. Du har drivkraft, är lyhörd och har lätt för att förhålla dig till förändrade omständigheter. Med tanke på verksamheternas utformning är det av stor vikt att du är bra på att kommunicera samt att du är trygg i dig själv.

Du har goda kunskaper i det svenska språket, såväl i tal som i skrift. Behärskar du andra språk är detta meriterande. B-körkort för manuellt växlad bil är önskvärt men inte ett krav.

Om arbetsplatsen

Vid Sveriges största arbetsmarknads- och socialförvaltning jobbar cirka 2900 medarbetare varje dag för att stärka Malmöbor. Tillsammans med Malmöborna vill vi öka möjligheterna till egen försörjning, minska hemlöshet, bidra till att barn och unga ska få bra uppväxtvillkor och verka för att nyanlända ska få goda förutsättningar. Det är ett viktigt och roligt arbete, men långt ifrån enkelt. Utmaningarna tar aldrig slut, och inte utvecklingsmöjligheterna heller.

Sök jobb hos oss, du kommer att göra skillnad!

Malmö stads verksamheter är organiserade i 14 förvaltningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att skapa välfärd och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Tillsammans med Malmöborna utvecklar vi en ännu bättre stad att bo, verka och vara i; olikheter, livserfarenheter och talanger gör Malmö till en smart stad i hjärtat av Europa. Världens kunskap finns här.

Läs om Malmö stad som arbetsgivare här http://www.malmo.se/jobb

Information om tjänsten

Anställningsform: Timanställning/Semestervikariat

Omfattning: Deltid

Antal tjänster: Ca 6

Tillträde: Semestervikariat november-januari. Man behöver kunna arbeta alla tider - dag/kväll/helg/natt.

Övrigt

Intervjuer kommer att ske under v.41 och v.42.

Endast kvinnor kan komma att anställas då tjänstens placering är vid ett skyddat boende.

Observera att vi i Malmö stad tagit bort det personliga brevet från ansökningsprocessen och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor, detta för en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess och en effektiv kandidatupplevelse för dig som söker jobb hos oss. Observera att de urvalsfrågor du har möjlighet att besvara i samband med din ansökan är av STOR VIKT i vårt urvalsarbete.

Innan anställning vill vi att du visar upp utdrag ur Polisens misstanke- och belastningsregister, HVB (hem för vård eller boende), socionomexamen (eller påbörjad socionomexamen) samt id-handling (pass eller nationellt id-kort).

Malmö stad strävar efter att medarbetarna ska representera den mångfald som finns i vår stad. Vi välkomnar därför sökande som kan bidra till att vi som arbetsgivare kan uppfylla Malmöbornas behov.
