jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/ep-cms-ec-2026-190-ld/

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.

We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle

Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.

Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

Has practical experience as a plumber

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria

    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent

    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

jobs.title: Part-Time Clinical Governance Lead – Home Support Services
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
farrell Care Solutions Limited is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Registered Nurse to act as Part-Time Clinical Governance Lead for our home support service. This important role will provide professional oversight and advice relating to the quality and safety of care and support delivered to service users in their homes. The successful candidate will help ensure that our Home Support Workers are appropriately trained, competent and supported to provide safe, respectful and person-centred services. They will work collaboratively with the Service Manager, Directors, Compliance Manager and operational team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide professional clinical-governance oversight and advice. Support the assessment and monitoring of Home Support Worker competency and training needs. Advise on care-related risks, incidents, safeguarding concerns and changes in service-user needs. Provide guidance when a service user’s needs may fall outside the organisation’s defined scope of service. Contribute to the development and review of care-related policies, procedures and practices. Support quality assurance, audits and continuous improvement. Promote dignity, privacy, independence, choice and person-centred practice. Support appropriate communication and escalation with healthcare professionals and the HSE. Maintain accurate records in accordance with confidentiality and data-protection requirements. ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS A recognised nursing qualification. Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI). Relevant post-registration nursing experience. Experience in healthcare, community care, older-person services, disability services or home support. Knowledge of clinical governance, safeguarding, risk management, quality and patient safety. Strong communication, professional judgement and record-keeping skills. Legal entitlement to work in Ireland. Experience in home support, community nursing, staff competency assessment, training, audit or healthcare management would be an advantage. This is a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week. The working pattern and flexibility required will be agreed with the successful candidate. Appointment will be subject to verification of qualifications and NMBI registration, identity checks, two professional references, Garda Vetting and/or international police clearance where applicable, and medical fitness. A driving licence and access to transport may be required. To apply, please submit an up-to-date CV and a short cover letter outlining your suitability for the role. Farrell Care Solutions Limited is an equal-opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Lapin ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!**

Haluatko johtaa omaa palvelualueettasi ja vastata asiakkuuksien, henkilöstön ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.

Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.

Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.

Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, esimerkiksi korkeakoulututkinto. Kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ja/tai palveluliiketoiminnasta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista. Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä työssä liikutaan asiakkaiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaisesti eri kohteiden välillä laajalla työskentelyalueella.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- kilpailukykyisen palkan n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa

- kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen


Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridityömallilla ja työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia asiakkaiden ja oman alueen tarpeiden mukaan.

**Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus**

Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Johdamme työyhteisöä yhdenvertaisesti ja kohtelemme kaikkia kunnioittavasti – emme hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa. Huolehdimme turvallisesta työympäristöstä ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista sekä toimimme vastuullisesti kaikessa tekemisessä.

**Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin**

Meillä viihdytään – työntekijöidemme eNPS on huipputasolla ja arjessamme näkyy arvostus, luottamus ja yhdessä onnistuminen. Olemme saaneet myös tunnustusta työstämme: Vuonna 2024 meidät valittiin Suomen ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi Vuonna 2025 sijoituimme samassa kategoriassa kolmannelle sijalle Vuonna 2025 saavutimme 3. sijan Suomen ihmisläheisin työelämäteko -kategoriassa

**Hae mukaan rakentamaan kasvutarinaamme!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 14.9.2026.** Ensimmäinen haastattelukierros pidetään Kuusamossa 1.10.2026, varaathan päivän etukäteen itsellesi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelujohtaja Kaisa Mäkinen 17.9. 13-14 ja 23.9. 16-17 puh. 0503764711.

jobs.title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Levi
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineers and Architects
jobs.description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Senior Software Engineers and Architects**

The Senior Software Engineers at Nolwenture are responsible for supporting both client and internal projects, playing to the individual's strengths within the project team – in the role of Lead Developer, Product Owner or Project Manager.

As a senior developer, you will work with modern technologies that are kept up-to-date by the entire team's contributions in order to keep our best practices current and ahead of the game. You will also support mid-level, junior and trainee level team members with their project tasks and broader learning and development.

You will work directly with our clients throughout the project lifecycle; gathering requirements, managing expectations, and helping to plan and coordinate delivery alongside the wider team.

For even more experienced and skilled candidates we also offer Architect level appointments.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- possess a strong understanding about software development

- have a desire to work on both web and mobile applications

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills; at Nolwenture we work very closely with our clients

- be comfortable working directly with clients and confident taking on light project management responsibilities (e.g. previous experience as a Scrum Product Owner or had Scrum Master duties or having run sessions on story mapping or requirement gathering)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new stuff and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools as part of our everyday workflow


We work with a variety of programming languages, but a JavaScript background will suit us well as we use a lot of NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native.

You will benefit from knowing additional languages (e.g. Swift, Kotlin and Python) and being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). A background in areas such as Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS, or other data visualisation and physics / simulations experience, DB (sql/postgres etc.), administration (DBA) is of interest to us too.

Furthermore, an interest or experience in AI/ML will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters ideally. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
The iCell (Immune Cell Therapy Research Group) at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, invites applications for a one-year fixed-term position as a Research Assistant. Our laboratory is located at the Biomedicum 1, Helsinki.
The iCell research group at Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a dynamic research group dedicated to advancing novel immunotherapies against cancer. Our primary interest lies in the research and development of CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies, aiming at addressing current clinical needs through innovative product development.

Our research focuses on NK cell modifications, expansion, persistence, and killing efficacy. We employ various techniques, including primary cell culture, base editing, flow cytometry, lentiviral transduction, cytotoxic assays, and in vivo models.

We have an opening for a motivated Research Assistant to work on genetic modifications and gene editing of CAR-NK cells to enhance their efficacy against cancer.

Main responsibilities

Performing laboratory experiments related to immune cell engineering and characterization
Conducting cell culture, molecular biology, and gene editing procedures
Assisting in data collection and documentation
Maintaining laboratory records and inventories
Supporting laboratory organization, equipment maintenance, and general operations
Collaborating with researchers and other team members in ongoing projects

Qualifications

The successful candidate holds a relevant degree in life sciences, biotechnology, biomedicine, or a related field and has practical laboratory experience, particularly in cell culture techniques.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
Immunology
Molecular biology
Gene editing technologies
GLP/GMP-compliant laboratory work

Bioinformatics expertise is considered an additional asset when combined with experience in one or more of the areas listed above.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated and proactive individual with a strong interest in laboratory-based research and development. They should be eager to learn new methods and technologies and possess excellent collaboration and communication skills.

What we offer

At the Blood Service, you will become part of a unique chain of help with voluntary donors and healthcare staff. We offer you an interesting and meaningful task as part of a motivated and professional team. Comprehensive orientation and support from your supervisor and team will help you get started in your work and develop in your own role. The well-being of our employees is particularly important to us: we invest in the well-being of our personnel e.g. by offering a wide range of sports and well-being benefits (see the list of benefits below). Read more about Blood Service as a workplace [here.](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/work-with-us/)

The position has a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension subject to project funding.

The salary for this position is determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Terveyspalveluala. The position is classified in Salary Grade 4, with a base salary of EUR 2847,83 per month for a full-time employee. In addition to the base salary, remuneration includes a personal salary component, which incorporates a length-of-service guarantee.

In this position, lentiviruses are handled, which might cause a health risk to an HIV-positive person. Therefore, this position is not suitable for an HIV-positive person, and the selected individual must regularly present an acceptable statement from occupational health services regarding their medical fitness.

How to apply and inquiries

In your application, please detail your experimental skills in cell culture, immunology, molecular biology, GLP/GMP-work, and gene editing, the duration of your experience with these techniques, and your motivation for research, development and lab work. Include preferably two possible references.

For more information on the position, please contact iCell group leader Helka Göös (helka.goos@bloodservice.fi).
Please submit your application through our electronic recruitment system. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.


Benefits


- Culture, sports, well-being and commuting benefits (Epassi)

- Extended occupational health care

- Lunch benefit

- Commuting exercise incentive

- Long vacations

- Employee sports benefits



Finnish Red Cross Blood Service

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service provides hospitals with safe and effective blood products and laboratory services that are essential for patient care. We also maintain the Stem Cell Registry and the Blood Service Biobank.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a non-profit organization. Our annual budget is approximately EUR 60 million, and we employ around 500 people.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service conducts active scientific research to advance biomedical knowledge in our areas of expertise. Read more about our Research Strategy [here](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/research/research-strategy/).

Email: hr@veripalvelu.fi Location: Haartmaninkatu 8

jobs.title: Work flexibly, earn extra - Join Imercos Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary job in November and December, with the opportunity to earn extra money and gain valuable work experience? Do you enjoy being physically active and working at a fast pace? Then now is the time to seize the opportunity!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4 shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

On a typical working day, you will pack approximately 100–150 boxes, depending on the size of the orders.

We expect you to:

  • Enjoy routine-based and independent work

  • Have a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for your shifts

  • Be physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the day

  • Have good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Be available for 4 shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Be available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We also offer an exciting temporary position in a well-established and busy retail company, where you will become part of a strong team with great team spirit. You will have the opportunity to work morning, evening, or night shifts, while earning extra money during the busy season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour. In addition, evening, night, and weekend supplements are provided.

Employment terms

Eventyrhuset består af to afdelinger med i alt ca. 110 børn - ca. 44 vuggestuebørn og ca. 66 børnehavebørn. Vores personalegruppe tæller omkring 30 dedikerede medarbejdere: pædagoger, medhjælpere, køkkenpersonale, gårdmand og administration.

Eventyrhuset har som privat institution en institutionsbestyrelse med det øverste ansvar for driften, økonomien og personalet, samt en engageret forældrebestyrelse som sikrer forældrenes stemme i beslutningsprocesserne og står for de sociale aktiviteter som sommerfest, julefest mm.

Børnehaven - hvor tryghed, leg og læring går hånd i hånd

I vores børnehave er der tre grupper med, hver med en normering på 22 børn. Hver gruppe har en fast stab bestående af to pædagoger og to medhjælpere.

Vi prioriterer fællesskab og samarbejde - både mellem børn og voksne og på tværs af stuerne. Hos os kender alle børn alle voksne, og det giver en tryg og tillidsfuld atmosfære i hverdagen.

Vi arbejder løbende med at styrke vores pædagogiske praksis, og vi har et fælles fokus på relationer, nærvær og det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling.

Din rolle som pædagog

Som pædagog i Eventyrhusets børnehave bliver du en del af en fast gruppe, hvor du - sammen med dine 3 stuekollegaer - får ansvaret for ca. 22 børn.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet kræver tid og forberedelse. Derfor har du som pædagog hos os hver uge 2 timer afsat til "andet arbejde", som f.eks. planlægning, refleksion og dokumentation - uden børn.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuer og faggrupper.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·       Har en uddannelse som pædagog.

·       Er professionel, omsorgsfuld og initiativrig.

·       Brænder for relationer, leg og nærvær i det pædagogiske arbejde.

·       Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

·       Har IT-kompetencer på brugerniveau (fordel, men ikke et krav).

Hvad får du hos os?

·       Mulighed for selv at vælge ugentligt timeantal.

·       2 timers forberedelsestid hver uge.

·       Betalt madordning med sund og lækker frokost.

·       Firma-betalt sundhedsforsikring - også for dine hjemmeboende børn.

·       Betalt ICDP-kursus, hvis du ikke allerede er uddannet.

·       En hverdag i skønne omgivelser med masser af udeliv.

·       Et sted, hvor nytænkning og faglig udvikling er en del af kulturen.

·       Ingen lukkedage i sommerferien, så du er selv med til at styre hvornår du holder ferie.

Ansættelsesvilkår

·       Stillingen er på det antal timer, som passer dig bedst.

·       Start: Hurtigst muligt - men vi venter gerne på den rette.

·       Løn og vilkår efter overenskomst med BUPL og Børneringen.

·       Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest og referencer som en del af processen.

Klar til nye eventyr?

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er nysgerrig på stillingen, så kontakt os endelig. Vi giver gerne en rundvisning, så du kan mærke stemningen selv. Du kan også læse mere om Eventyrhuset på vores hjemmeside: www.eventyrhuset.info.

Send din ansøgning og CV til post@eventyrhuset.info eller kontakt os på tlf. 28760260, hvis du vil besøge os først.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, og lukker annoncen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Eventyrhuset… Her bliver hverdagens øjeblikke til noget helt særligt

jobs.title: Chefs for the Parliament Restaurant at Christiansborg Palace
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about great food and looking to use your culinary skills in a kitchen where no two days are the same? Would you like to work in a unique environment that combines historic surroundings, high ambitions, and a vibrant atmosphere?

At Christiansborg Palace, home of the Danish Parliament, every day brings new experiences. We follow the rhythm of parliamentary life, where meetings, conferences, official events, and political activities create a workplace full of energy, variety, and opportunities to grow.

A Workplace Defined by Quality, Variety, and Team Spirit

At Christiansborg, we prepare daily lunch and dinner services, operate cafés, and provide catering for events of all sizes.

On busy days, we can serve up to 1,200 guests across the Parliament's restaurants, cafés, and event venues. During elections, major political events, and special occasions, the pace increases and priorities can change quickly. This creates a dynamic and exciting working environment where flexibility and teamwork are essential.

You will become part of a team of more than 20 colleagues, including chefs, kitchen staff, waiters, and service professionals who work closely together to achieve a common goal: delivering outstanding dining experiences for our guests every single day.

Your Responsibilities

  • Preparing hot and cold dishes with a focus on quality, flavour, and seasonal ingredients

  • Producing catering for conferences, receptions, and special events

  • Contributing ideas for menu planning, with a strong focus on reducing food waste

  • Providing friendly and professional service to guests

  • Supporting smooth kitchen operations and assisting where needed

  • Working with food safety procedures, hygiene standards, and daily quality controls

Working Hours

Working hours are scheduled between 06:00 and 21:00 and will be agreed upon individually.

Evening and weekend shifts will occur in connection with events and special functions.

Who Are You?

You are a trained chef with experience from a staff restaurant, catering operation, large-scale kitchen, restaurant, or a similar environment. Above all, you have a genuine passion for food and enjoy working in a fast-paced and varied setting.

In addition, we are looking for someone who:

  • Works in a structured and responsible manner

  • Has a strong eye for quality, detail, and the overall guest experience

  • Is welcoming, service-minded, and professional when interacting with guests

  • Remains calm and adaptable when priorities change

  • Has a positive attitude towards teamwork and enjoys finding solutions rather than obstacles

What We Offer

  • A permanent full-time position (37 hours per week)

  • A strong and supportive team culture with skilled and dedicated colleagues

  • An exciting and varied working day in one of Denmark's most vibrant institutions

  • The support and opportunities of Compass Group, including professional and personal development

  • Attractive employment terms covered by a collective agreement, including pension scheme, flexible benefits savings programme, healthcare plan, and employee discounts

We are looking for new colleagues to join us as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Ready to Join the Team?

Send us your CV today.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

Important Information

Please note that all employees working at Christiansborg Palace must be able to obtain the required security clearance.

And will be a part of all oure units

jobs.title: Lindebjerg A/S søger en Mekaniker til teknisk klargøring
jobs.description:
VIL DU VÆRE EN DEL AF EN LANDSDÆKKENDE SUCCES?

Er du en praktisk anlagt person med hænderne godt skruet på – og har du lyst til at blive en vigtig del af et stærkt team i vækst? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en effektiv og engageret mekaniker til vores afdeling i Middelfart, hvor du bliver en del af et dedikeret team, der sikrer høj kvalitet i vores produkter – både før og efter levering til kunderne.

️ Hvad skal du lave?

Som mekaniker får du en alsidig hverdag med både klargøring og tekniske opgaver. Dine primære arbejdsområder vil være:

 

  • ✅ Reparation og servicering af kundescootere

  • ✅ Teknisk klargøring af nye og brugte scootere

  • ✅ Montering af ekstraudstyr

  • ✅ Kvalitetssikring og slutkontrol

  • ✅ Vedligeholdelse og orden i værkstedet sammen med dine kollegaer

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har teknisk snilde og evt. erfaring fra værksted eller lignende

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og går op i kvalitet

  • Trives med både rutineprægede og varierende opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt i et team

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at tage fat, når der er travlt

Erfaring med el-køretøjer eller reparation er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En spændende hverdag med masser af ansvar og variation

  • Et uformelt og hjælpsomt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og en arbejdsplads i vækst

  • Mulighed for at blive en del af en landsdækkende virksomhed med ambitioner

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV med billede til job@lindebjerg.dk. Skriv "Mekaniker" i emnefeltet.

Der afholdes løbende samtaler, så vi opfordrer interesserede kandidater til at søge snarest muligt.

Om Lindebjerg

DEN GODE SERVICE ER DET VIGTIGSTE FOR OS
Det er vores fornemste opgave at have tilfredse kunder. Dette opnår vi ved at sætte vores kunder i centrum ved altid at være service minded, have top engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere, sælge kvalitetsprodukter, samt altid at være omstillingsparate, så vi kan tilpasse os vores kunders behov.

Lindebjerg er blandt landets absolut førende leverandører af el-køretøjer indenfor vores branche. Vi har solgt mere end 15000 køretøjer, som i dag kører på de danske landeveje.

Virksomheden er landsdækkende. Vores hovedkontor er placeret i Middelfart og lokationen råder over hele 2600 kvadratmeter fordelt på showroom, lager, værksted og administration. Udover vores hovedkontor, har vi showrooms fordelt i hele Danmark, derved kan vi altid være tæt på vores kunder. Vi er netop i gang med åbning af to nye showrooms, herudover har vi lokationer i Aabenraa, Esbjerg, Holstebro, Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Sorø, Hillerød og København.

Hos Lindebjerg sætter vi en ære i at omsætte ideer til handling og sidder derfor også med helt fremme i bussen når det handler om at forretningsudvikle, inden for branchen. 
I dagligdagen tilbyder vi stor frihed under ansvar og vægter det sunde arbejdsmiljø og godt kollegaskab, i et uformelt miljø, højt.
