Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

jobs.title: SMB Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a marketing professional who combines strategy and execution, owning demand gen programs and campaigns for the SMB sales segment and startups in Japan. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including the Japan sales org, Japan and global marketing teams, and external agencies—to plan and deliver programs that drive results.

In addition, this role supports growth of Notion’s startup program by building awareness and driving trial acquisition, partnering with the Global/APAC startup team to execute marketing activities and recruit partners.

You may also support other marketing initiatives to unlock the full potential of the business in Japan.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Develop a strong understanding of the Notion product and the SMB user/buyer journey to identify the highest-impact plays for the segment. Partner with SMB Sales leadership to set program priorities, define target audiences and goals, and align on campaign plans—proactively communicating progress, results, and learnings to stakeholders.

 - Own end-to-end execution of events and webinars—from planning and logistics through day-of delivery and post-event lead management—translating the agreed program plan into flawless execution. Partner closely with SDRs to ensure timely follow-up, clean lead handoffs, and maximum pipeline impact.

 - Execute demand gen campaigns in our marketing automation platform (e.g., nurture/engagement programs), including audience/segmentation setup and campaign builds, in coordination with Japan + global marketing teams on content and messaging (e.g., gated offers).

 - Partner with APAC Marketing Ops and BizTech to keep GTM systems running smoothly (marketing automation platform, Salesforce, Outreach, Sansan)—including intake/ticketing, operational processes, and system governance (e.g., lead scoring changes, integrations, and best practices).

 - Own lead and pipeline reporting for the SMB segment, tracking key KPIs and regularly assessing pipeline health to inform optimizations across programs.

 - Increase awareness of the Notion for Startups program among early-stage startups and drive acquisition of startup trials through localized, high-velocity campaigns.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5–7 years of experience managing and executing demand generation programs and campaigns for B2B companies.

 - Proven track record of hitting aggressive growth goals by leveraging campaigns such as email and webinars, with expertise in end-to-end campaign development, execution, and measurement.

 - Proficiency with marketing automation platforms, SFDC, Outreach, Sansan and Figma.

 - Customer-centric and insight-driven. You understand the customer journey and each influencer in the decision-making process, and you use customer insights to design campaigns.

 - Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills. You’ve worked closely with sales, content, SDRs and operations partners.

 - Experience planning and executing webinars from start to finish.

 - Previous experience working with global teams.

 - Proficient in fluent-level Japanese and business-level English, both written and verbal.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - A builder mindset




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Be a Notion power user and are already an advocate for the tool.

 - Track record of interacting with startup founders, VC firms, and incubators




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

Job Snapshot

Location: Remote - California (San Diego or Southern California Preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $28-30 per hour

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Environment: Remote

Reports To: Human Resources Manager

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

  • Speak with integrityâclear, respectful, and honest in every interaction
  • Embrace innovation, trying new ideas, learning fast, and improving care.
  • Own our roles, staying accountable for outcomes and documenting accurately
  • Build genuine connections with members, families, and teammates through empathy and cultural sensitivity
  • Lead with trust by being consistent, transparent, and following through
  • Celebrate wins together, recognizing individual and team achievements
  • Collaborate with purpose, partnering across departments and with community providers to solve problems
  • Ask for support and offer support, because thriving together is how we serve our members best

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.



This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.



You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS, YOU WILL:

 - Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

 - Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

 - Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

 - Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

 - Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

 - Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

 - Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

 - Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

 - Partner with regional and functional leaders to turn local learnings into repeatable playbooks, programs, and operating cadences.

 - Create measurement, reporting, and review mechanisms that help teams understand what is working and where to focus.

 - Support the design of customer growth motions that connect Sales, Services, and Partners.

 - Help codify best practices so growth becomes part of the standard operating rhythm, not a set of one-off campaigns.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from idea to operational execution.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience in management consulting, investment banking, business operations, or post-sales GTM operations.

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; you can turn ambiguous business questions into clear frameworks, insights, and recommendations.

 - Proven ability to design and manage cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.

 - Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders and operating teams, with the ability to align people around a shared plan.

 - Excellent written communication, including crisp strategy docs, program plans, executive updates, and field-facing materials.

 - Comfort working in a global organization where programs need a strong central strategy and room for regional adaptation.

 - Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and bring structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work.

 - Strong business judgment and curiosity about what drives customer adoption, retention, and expansion.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with usage-based, consumption-based, or product-led growth models.

 - Experience building or scaling global programs across multiple regions or customer segments.

 - Exposure to pricing, packaging, services, partners, or monetization initiatives.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. Key Deliverables Include

  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI.  - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

jobs.title: Human Resources Specialist
jobs.description:
Harvey Nash USA has been engaged to find a talented HR Operations Specialist for a leading healthcare organization committed to delivering exceptional employee experiences through operational excellence.


Job Title: HR Operations Specialist

Location: Remote (California Residents Only)

Duration: 6-Month Contract


About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused HR Operations Specialist to join a dynamic HR team. This role is responsible for supporting a wide range of HR operations and employee inquiries while ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality service delivery. The ideal candidate is resourceful, takes ownership of their work, communicates effectively, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Review HRIS transactional process requests daily and weekly, approving or rejecting transactions based on established HR policies and procedures.
  • Understand core HR policies and processes to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant transaction processing.
  • Escalate complex transactional issues and policy-related questions to HR leadership when appropriate.
  • Manage employee HR cases, calls, and chats involving benefits, compensation, wellness programs, leave of absence, payroll, performance management, and other HR-related inquiries.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional HR teams including Benefits, Payroll, HR Technology, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Retirement, Eligibility, and Corporate Real Estate to resolve employee issues.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service by managing cases with accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism while enhancing the employee experience.
  • Identify trends in employee inquiries and partner with leadership on process improvements or escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted HR resource while ensuring compliance with organizational policies and service standards.


Must-Have Skills

  • Resourceful and self-sufficient with the ability to work independently and efficiently.
  • Demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and a growth mindset by learning quickly and embracing feedback.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-first approach.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, and employee support functions.
  • Experience handling HR service requests or HR operations in a shared services or HR support environment.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Oracle HCM.
  • Experience with UKG (Ultipro) and/or ServiceNow.
  • Passion for Human Resources with broad HR knowledge; SHRM-CP certification is a plus.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting multiple HR Centers of Excellence.


Education

  • Associate's or bachelorâs degree in human resources or a related field OR 5+ years of HR experience in lieu of a degree.


A reasonable, good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum hourly wage for this position is $25.00 - $29.00 per hour on W2, depending on experience.


About Us

Harvey Nash is a national, full-service talent management firm specializing in technology and professional staffing. Our company was founded with a mission to serve as the talent partner of choice by connecting exceptional talent with leading organizations across a wide range of industries.

jobs.description:

Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

OULA HEALTH

Product Manager

Full-Time

  • New York, Chicago or Charlotte
  • Reports to VP, Central Operations

About Oula

Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems â including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health â to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

The Role

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.

You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.

What You'll Own

EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems

  • Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
  • Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
  • Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert â FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
  • Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
  • Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
  • Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch

Product Operations & Launch

  • Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations â standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
  • Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
  • Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows

Standards & Knowledge Management

  • Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable â documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
  • Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
  • Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets

Data & Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
  • Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
  • Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

What You Bring

  • 3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work â ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity â you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
  • Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines â ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
  • Ability to speak âmultiple languagesâ â comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
  • Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.

At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

Compensation & Details

Salary: $110,000 â $140,000 depending on experience and location

Equity: Options commensurate with level

Location: Preference for New York/New Jersey/Connecticut, Chicago or Charlotte Remote-flexible with periodic travel to clinic locations and health system partners

Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Oula is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone's contributions are valued.

jobs.description:
About HiredBuddy

At HiredBuddy, we connect domain specialists and subject-matter experts with leading AI research labs to shape and train the next generation of artificial intelligence. We focus on high-quality data annotation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation across various domains, ranging from STEM and software engineering to linguistics and data science.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Junior Data Analyst based in the United States to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring dataset quality, analyzing annotator performance metrics, optimizing labeling pipelines, and delivering insights that improve our AI training data pipelines.

This is an ideal role for an early-career analyst passionate about the intersection of data, machine learning, and AI operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Quality Assurance: Audit, clean, and validate large datasets generated by our network of AI trainers and domain experts to ensure high precision and adherence to guidelines.
  • Performance & Metrics Tracking: Analyze annotator accuracy, turnaround times, and throughput using SQL, Python, and BI dashboards to help optimize operations.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, AI Specialists, and Product) to identify bottlenecks in data labeling pipelines and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and update daily/weekly operational reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and client leads.
  • Guideline Calibration: Analyze edge cases and error patterns in dataset outputs to help refine project annotation instructions and rubrics.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelorâs degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency with SQL for data querying, aggregation, and analysis.
  • Practical knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas).
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail when working with complex datasets.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly translate data findings into actionable insights for non-technical team members.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, data annotation workflows, or RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
  • Prior experience or internship experience in an operations-focused analyst role.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • Cutting-Edge Industry Exposure: Gain hands-on experience at the forefront of AI model training and evaluation.
  • Growth Opportunities: Direct mentorship and opportunities to advance within a fast-growing tech environment.
  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly/Salaried rate commensurate with experience.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Area Sales Manager

Reports to:       

Director of Sales- East

Location:         

Remote- New York Metro

Status:              

FT/Exempt

Compensation:

$70,000 â $80,000 annual base salary, plus a competitive bonus opportunity. Final compensation will be commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.


More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

ROAR Organic is seeking a hands-on Sales Leader to drive profitable growth in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.


The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. They are highly relationship-driven, resourceful, and action-oriented, with strong communication and organizational skills. This leader excels at building and implementing the strategies, tools, and processes needed to support sustained growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver against Annual Operating Plan targets, including gross/net sales and trade spend objectives.
  • Grow distribution and topline revenue with a focus on regional and independent retailers.
  • Execute customer sales strategies, promotional calendars, and account plans.
  • Leverage distributer incentive programs and independent retailer promotional opportunities to drive sales.
  • Conduct weekly route rides with distributor sales representatives to support execution and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and own a field execution strategy based on weekly trend reports, promotional planners, and merchandising opportunities.
  • Manage and execute trade spend programs to drive profitable growth and promotional effectiveness.
  • Leverage syndicated data (IRI, SPINS) to communicate compelling, retailer-specific presentations.
  • Track, measure, and analyze performance metrics, including ROI.
  • Represent the brand at regional and national trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events.

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 2 years of CPG sales experience.
  • Strong understanding of the beverage and grocery landscape, including retailers and distributors.
  • Experience executing sales planning initiatives.
  • Creative, solutions-oriented problem solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated data tools (SPINS, IRI) preferred.
  • Ability to travel extensively as needed.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Director
jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

Key Responsibilities As a Support Coordinator

  • Assist NDIS participants in implementing their NDIS Plans and coordinating their services and supports.
  • Complete all necessary administration to the required standard, ensuring full compliance.
  • Maintain and develop relationships with quasi-government bodies and disability associations/groups.
  • Take ownership of developing and retaining these networks.

To be successful in this role you will need to have:

  • Your empathy and care for people
  • Your ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups, managers, clients, and customers

  • Minimum 6 months to 1 year of experience working as an NDIS Support Coordinator

About MyIntegra, Part Of The APM Group

Since 2016, MyIntegra has empowered people with disabilities by helping NDIS participants maximize their plans and access support services. We provide Plan Management and Support Coordination services, using best-in-class tools and technologies across Australia.

jobs.title: Program Administration Manager
jobs.description:
Campaigns

  • Full Time
  • Remote / Occasional Travel
  • Salary $75,000 - $100,000

Organization Overview

Greenlight America is the leading grassroots campaign force powering the nation's clean energy transition at the local level. Our team supports local residents and organizations working to get clean energy built in their communities. Since our founding in 2023, we have enabled volunteers to advance thousands of megawatts' worth of utility-scale projects across the country, helping hundreds of communities to say yes to the benefits of a clean energy future.

Position Overview

Greenlight America is hiring a Program Administration Manager to help lead program administration and operations for our growing campaigns department.

The Program Administration Manager supports the Senior Director of Campaigns in running a growing department. They build department-wide systems, support internal communications, and lead special projects, while also managing core operational functions and providing executive support to the Senior Director. Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. The successful candidate will be a highly organized, proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative to build better systems, and brings strong professional judgment. They will genuinely enjoy working as part of a team and build trust easily across people and functions. The Program Administration Manager reports to the Senior Director of Campaigns.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Program Administration â 50%

  • Design and improve department-wide systems and structures, working closely with the Senior Director to identify gaps and build practical, scalable solutions.
  • Serve as the lead for the department retreat and other all-team convenings, from logistics through content flow.
  • Design onboarding, structure, and support systems for a new department internship/fellowship program.
  • Establish and maintain a regular department communication cadence (e.g. weekly updates, department call recaps), including best practices and norms for internal comms.
  • Draft and/or coordinate internal communications on behalf of the Senior Director, including the weekly department update.
  • Maintain organized department files, shared resources, and documentation so the team can work efficiently.
  • Support culture and engagement efforts for the department, in partnership with the Senior Director.
  • Provide light-touch executive support to the Senior Director, including coordinating travel logistics and arranging team gestures for staff.
  • Take on ad hoc special projects at the Senior Director's direction as departmental needs evolve.

Campaign Operations Management â 50%

  • Coordinate with Ops on the campaigns department's budget management, including designing better systems for tracking expenditures, flagging variances, and working with staff and finance to keep spending on track.
  • Identify gaps in departmental operations systems and processes and develop practical solutions that scale with the team's growth.
  • Manage campaign operational workflows such as contractor invoicing and train campaign staff on those workflows.
  • Build and maintain campaign systems for accurate expense categorization, ensuring campaign staff understand and follow financial protocols.
  • Proactively coordinate work across campaign staff, operations staff, and other key stakeholders using clear, direct, and thoughtful communication.
  • Drive adoption of financial and operational practices through effective communication, rollout, and follow-up.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for campaign staff, contractors, and others, addressing operational questions with a caring, helpful approach.
  • Support onboarding coordination for new campaigns department hires.

Experience And Qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates with the following qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant program administration or operations experience, ideally in a nonprofit, campaign, or mission-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of building and implementing systems and processes. Familiarity with project management and automation tools (e.g. Asana, Zapier) is a plus.
  • Experience rolling out new processes and driving adoption with a team, including situations without direct management authority.
  • Experience with budget management and financial tracking; comfort working with spreadsheets and financial data.
  • Experience working with a senior leader to translate department priorities and goals into action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting communications on behalf of senior leaders.
  • Comfort and experience building relationships, communicating, and coordinating work with staff across an organization, including leadership and staff outside the assigned department.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a responsive point of contact to field incoming questions, support problem-solving, and resolve issues in a way that builds trust.
  • Exercises discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Excitement for taking systems built in a fast-growing organization and bringing them to the next level of maturity and sophistication; comfortable identifying problems and building solutions from scratch.
  • Proactive, self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfort in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built and flexibility is required.
  • Passion for accelerating the clean energy transition.

Compensation And Benefits

The base annual salary for this position is $75,000-$100,000. We offer an excellent benefits package which includes 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, monthly technology stipend, and retirement contributions through 401k and Roth plans.

TO APPLY

  • Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. If you require accommodations so that you may participate in the selection process, please email accommodations@greenlightamerica.org.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 4-7+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $216,000 - $276,000 per year.

The User Operations team is a function of the Customer Experience (CX) team maintaining clear lines of communication between customers and Product, ensuring customers get the most out of Notion and that their feedback is integrated into the product development process.

As the Technical Quality Program Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining world class support experiences related to product quality. You’ll be responsible for improving the bug reporter experience and maintaining and scaling processes for tracking and resolution of user issues related to product quality and feature requests.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Manage critical user experiences and internal workflows focused on improving product quality, influencing the development of new features, and supporting end users at scale

 - Continuously improve Notion’s bug-reporting and feature request funnels, from user-facing intake to escalation, tagging, tracking, reporting, and followup

 - Make data-informed recommendations for how to collect and prioritize feature requests, scale internal escalation processes, and resolve bugs and other product quality issues

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to measure and drive CX’s bug management effectiveness and efficiency through tooling, process, and training improvements

 - Collaborate with Engineering to improve incident management workflows, ensuring clear escalation paths, timely communication, and effective resolution of customer-impacting issues

 - Build and maintain documentation, trainings, and QA processes for customer support issues related to quality, reliability, performance, and qualitative product feedback

 - Be an advocate for our customers and a thought partner to CX and Product partners




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3-5 years experience in customer support operations, product operations, technical support, customer experience, or related field

 - Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to streamline cross-functional programs or processes

 - Experience working directly with engineers, product managers, or other technical roles as well as CX or customer-facing roles

 - Demonstrated experience solving ambiguous problems and using data to build consensus

 - Previous responsibility tracking and analyzing key operational metrics to ensure KPIs/service goals are met




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Notion product expertise

 - Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification

 - Technical knowledge or data querying experience (SQL)

 - Experience contributing to the product development process at a software company
